title: Script
scene: A middle-school student holds a small plain cue card at waist height in one hand and practices a calm conversation with a seated classmate. The cue card has only three simple horizontal colored bars, not letters. A small empty speech bubble suggests rehearsing words before needing them. The other hand rests naturally at the student's side. Focus on prepared practice, uncluttered classroom corner.
alt: A student practices speaking with a classmate while holding a cue card with three plain bars; an empty speech bubble represents the rehearsed words.
